## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible issue and what this change does. Link a related issue
when one exists.

## Validation

List the relevant existing tests and one complete workflow you exercised.
Documentation-only changes need link/content checks, not an unrelated app build.
For changed file mutations, include the relevant conflict/failure and Undo or
recovery outcome. State unexercised cases plainly.

For visual changes, include a normal/enlarged view and note Reduce Motion
behavior. Use disposable data and keep private paths or credentials out of media.

## Scope and follow-up

Call out compatibility limits, remaining work and any deliberate behavior change.
Keep unrelated refactors separate; reuse the existing targets and feature owners.

## Credits and sources

If the change includes another person's code or assets, credit them and link the
source and license. No CLA statement or copyright assignment is required.
